name: Import an audio file and play the original recording
description: Verifies supported audio including Opus and Apple MPEG-4/M4A recordings loads and the transport starts the actual local source audio.
steps: Import a supported audio recording, Opus voice recording, or Apple MPEG-4/M4A recording
expected: The source metadata and workspace are visible and the transport enters PLAYING state for the imported recording.

name: Run DeepFilterNet on speech and podcast profiles without redundant denoising
description: Verifies speech-oriented profiles use DeepFilterNet without a second spectral denoiser or noise gate being stacked afterward.
steps: Import a supported speech or podcast recording
Select Speech or Podcast under Source Profile
Switch to B Processed and play the result
expected: DeepFilterNet processing completes locally; optional hum, click/pop and de-essing stages remain available, but the extra spectral denoiser and gate are not applied to speech/podcast profiles.

name: Keep music and singing on the conservative restoration path
covers: frequency-selective profile denoising in Static mode
avoid stacking profile denoising with FFmpeg spectral denoising
description: Verifies music and singing profiles avoid the speech-oriented model, use smoothed spectral denoising, and do not gate tails by default.
steps: Import a music mix or singing recording
Select Music or Singing under Source Profile
expected: The app uses conservative local DSP for Music and Singing, estimates quiet-section level across channels without mono cancellation, and Auto Restore suggests lower denoising strength and a more conservative noise-floor target for musical sources. Users can select a noise-only region of at least 0.25 seconds; the app captures an averaged spectral profile from that region, measures its RMS level, and uses the captured spectrum for frequency-selective attenuation in Static mode for Music and Singing without stacking the FFmpeg spectral denoiser. The diagnosis advises A/B-checking tails, cymbals and reverb. Gating remains off unless Adaptive mode is explicitly raised above the conservative threshold.

name: Scale reconstruction according to the selected strength
description: Verifies reconstruction strength blends the interpolated repair with the original samples instead of applying the same full-strength replacement at every nonzero setting.
steps: Set Reconstruction to a low nonzero value
Repeat on the same source with a higher Reconstruction value
expected: The selected repair region uses the configured strength as a blend amount; zero strength leaves the source untouched by reconstruction.

name: Use static denoising mode and retain truthful failure states on mobile
description: Verifies the non-tracking denoising mode is labeled Static, repair controls remain available, and local processing failures are reported truthfully.
steps: Enable a repair control if needed
If the local processing engine fails, observe the status area
expected: Static mode is labeled accurately, repair controls remain available, and a processing failure is reported without claiming a successful export.
